verdict.rationale: Vue exposes an extensive, well-documented public JavaScript API (reactivity system, component API, error reference) plus an llms.txt endpoint specifically structured for AI consumption, letting an AI-native user drive the framework programmatically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually building/automating via this API, and no formal machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all 404, though that's expected for a client-side library).
